changes.after: A trait is a group of methods a class can reuse. Two traits here offer the same method name.

before: A trait supplies reusable members inserted into classes with use. It is not itself an instantiable object and is not an interface type. This use inside a class is different from importing a namespace name.

When two traits provide the same method, insteadof selects which implementation wins. An as clause can add an alias without deleting the original method. The class explicitly chooses A for label below.
